set count = 0
while @count < 4
    set count = @count + 1
    if @count == 2
        continue
    if @count == 4
        break
    print @count
set n = 2
repeat @n times
    set n = @n + 1
print @n
return
print "UNREACHABLE"

set value = 10
flow add_one
    set value = @input + 1
command DOUBLE
    set answer = @input + @input
add_one 4 as @next
DOUBLE @next as @total
print @total
print @value

context
    print "INJECTED"
    @missing
as @background
set label = "Ana"
print "Hello:" @label
print "@label"
set raw = """first
@missing
# literal"""
print @raw
do Return exactly the string DONE as @result
print @result

use guide.md#rules as @guide
use child.flow
print "ROOT:" @shared

print "BEFORE"
set label = "Ana Maria"
run python3 - @label
    import sys
    print(sys.argv[1])
as @process
print @process.stdout
print @process.exit_code

print "BEFORE"
run python3 - as @process
    import sys
    print("DIAGNOSTIC")
    sys.exit(7)
print "MUST_NOT_PRINT"

flow no_result
    set result = 5
    if true
        print "INNER"
no_result as @answer
print "MUST_NOT_PRINT"

set item = {"total": 3}
if true or @missing
    print @item.total
if false and @missing
    print "MUST_NOT_PRINT"
else
    print [1, 2]
###
print "COMMENT"
###
print "END"

async first
    run python3 -
        import time
        from pathlib import Path
        time.sleep(0.1)
        Path("first.txt").write_text("A")
    set value = "A"
async second
    run python3 -
        import time
        from pathlib import Path
        time.sleep(0.1)
        Path("second.txt").write_text("B")
    set value = "B"
await first
await second
await first
print @first.value
print @second.value

print "READY"
ask "Type yes to continue." as @answer
if @answer is exactly "yes"
    print "ACCEPTED"
else
    print "DECLINED"
return
print "UNREACHABLE"
